mainEntity.name: What can users trade on FXFunds?

acceptedAnswer.text: FXFunds identifies forex, cryptocurrencies, precious metals, stocks and futures among the financial market categories described on its website.
FXFunds identifies foreign exchange as one of its trading categories. Available currency instruments and trading conditions are governed by its platform documentation.
Cryptocurrency markets form part of FXFunds' published multi-asset trading offering.

mainEntity.name: Does FXFunds offer decentralised finance services?

acceptedAnswer.text: The FXFunds website describes decentralised finance concepts including smart contracts, lending, liquidity provision and blockchain-based transactions.
FXFunds describes stablecoins as a transaction medium intended to connect digital asset infrastructure with its broader multi-asset trading model.

mainEntity.name: Does FXFunds support USDT deposits and withdrawals?

acceptedAnswer.text: FXFunds lists USDT networks as payment options. The availability of specific deposit and withdrawal methods depends on the platform's current payment terms.

mainEntity.name: What blockchain networks does FXFunds list?

acceptedAnswer.text: Its payment information identifies TON, Ethereum ERC-20 and Tron TRC-20 for USDT transactions.
FXFunds describes smart contracts as part of its blockchain-focused platform model. Smart contracts are programs that execute predefined instructions on compatible blockchain networks.
Multi-signature technology allows selected digital asset transactions to require authorisation from multiple designated parties, supporting additional transaction controls.
FXFunds references smart-contract audits in its platform materials. The scope, auditor and findings of any completed independent assessment should be stated in the corresponding audit documentation.
Withdrawal requests are subject to the applicable account procedures, identity-verification requirements, supported payment methods and transaction terms.
FXFunds highlights quick withdrawals in its platform presentation. Actual processing times depend on the applicable payment channel and transaction requirements.

mainEntity.name: How does FXFunds approach platform security?

acceptedAnswer.text: FXFunds describes a security-focused technical framework involving blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts, multi-signature wallet technology and decentralised systems.

FXFunds describes several security-related technologies. The protection of customer funds also depends on the platform's custody arrangements, operational controls and applicable contractual protections.

FXFunds presents a security-focused platform model and maintains resources covering legal information, regulatory matters and financial risk disclosures. Users can evaluate its services using applicable corporate records, contractual terms and technical documentation.

mainEntity.name: Is FXFunds registered with the U.S. SEC?

acceptedAnswer.text: FXFUNDS LTD appears in SEC EDGAR records under CIK 0002137376 following a Form D filing. A Form D is a securities-offering notice, not a brokerage licence or SEC endorsement.

mainEntity.name: Does an SEC filing mean FXFunds is approved by the SEC?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The SEC's acceptance of a Form D filing does not indicate endorsement or approval of the company, its investment products or its trading platform.

mainEntity.name: Does FXFunds have a FinCEN registration?

acceptedAnswer.text: FXFunds has supplied documentation describing a FinCEN money services business registration. An MSB registration concerns activities within the applicable money services framework and does not, by itself, authorise securities, forex brokerage or derivatives trading.

Regulatory permissions depend on the specific operating entity, jurisdiction and financial services involved. Applicable licences and their scope should be identified through official regulatory records.
